description: Investigate published software architecture and plan changes with commit-pinned source evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Understand systems and plan changes with evidence
interface.longDescription: Explore public published software architecture, trace relationships and captured source evidence, and plan changes with explicit assumptions and validation. Uses read-only tools.
defaultPrompt: Find the Atlas for source-for/atlas and explain how Ask works, with source evidence.

Use the Atlas for source-for/atlas to plan cancellable Ask requests. Identify affected contracts, assumptions, implementation order and validation; distinguish the pinned publication from current code.
